hooks.command: cmd=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("command", ""))' 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$cmd" in *'git push'*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && ./gradlew -q spotlessCheck >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'BLOCKED: ./gradlew spotlessCheck failed. Run ./gradlew spotlessApply, commit the formatting, then push (AGENTS.md Critical Rule 1).' >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
